messages:
harper: Heads-up: planning a constrained FK backfill on orders.customer_id -> customers.id tonight during 01:30-03:00 UTC. main goal: avoid table locks and keep replicas healthy.
dinesh: +1. what's our gating criteria?
harper: canary 5% for 20m; chunked updates w/ chunk_size=2500, sleep=1s between chunks. worker_pool=8. abort if any shard holds a lock >4m or if replica lag >120s for >3 consecutive checks.
rachel: add abort if application error rate for canary tenants >7%. also we'll pin service-image to v2026.03.15-3 for the duration.
harper: deploybot, schedule job fk-backfill-20260321 at 2026-03-21T01:45:00Z. canary window 01:45-02:05 UTC.
deploybot: @harper scheduled fk-backfill-20260321 at 2026-03-21T01:45:00Z. Canary 5% 20m then ramp over 25m. Will post status messages. :white_check_mark:
dinesh: pin runtime-scheduler to commit 4fa2b1 for the window to prevent recent allocator changes from touching the worker pool.
deploybot: runtime-scheduler pinned to 4fa2b1 for fk-backfill-20260321.
harper: rollback playbook (short): 1) disable feature flag "cust_fk_enable" -> stops new backfill jobs; 2) set app pin back to v2026.03.14-7; 3) run revert script for affected rows if partial applied.
rachel: put the revert sql here for quick copy:
```
-- revert applied backfill rows for job id
UPDATE orders SET customer_id = previous_customer_id WHERE backfill_job_id = '20260321-fk-01' AND applied_at IS NOT NULL;
```
dinesh: operational checks to run during:
- watch pg_locks for locks on orders_shard_*
- watch replica_lag metric (db.replication.lag_seconds)
- watch app errors and 5xx rates for canary tenants

dinesh: query to surface long-running update queries:
```
SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active' AND query ILIKE '%UPDATE orders%'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

pagerduty-bot: If replica_lag > 120s for >3 checks, paging @dinesh.
rachel: we also added a safety sentinel: worker acquires per-shard lease key in redis with TTL 5m; if lease lost, worker aborts and notifies channel.
harper: abort criteria summary (added to release notes): >4m lock on any shard OR replica lag >120s sustained OR canary errors >7% OR lease lost on >2 workers.
dinesh: tests done: staging dry-run processed ~1.2M rows with median chunk duration 18s. abort path tested successfully.
harper: adding small runtime tweak: backfill will run with statement_timeout=120000 (120s) to fail fast on unexpected locks.
rachel: release notes link: https://internal/releases/2026-03-fk-backfill. Please skim before window.
dinesh: during window i'll be in channel from 01:30-03:30 UTC. pager on.
harper: final checklist at T-20m: ensure pins, pins verified in deploy dashboard, revoke any pending non-essential deploys.
rachel: also note: migrations team will disable non-critical analytics writes during canary to reduce contention.
harper: ok, unless there are objections i'll proceed. :rocket:
dinesh: no objections. go for it.
deploybot: Reminder: fk-backfill-20260321 will announce start at 2026-03-21T01:45:00Z in #eng-releases.
